title: One lawyer note with its gold answer and its history
description: One JSON object per line in a .jsonl file. The same shape for training, development, challenge, clean, composed, probe, mirror and hidden notes. Writers and relabellers give quotes; the script build-spans adds the positions. Only the keywords type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, const and $ref are used.

id.description: Stable and meaningless: n-000123. Never encodes the claim type.

set.description: specs/notes-pipeline.md, section 7. crossCheck was removed on 14 November 2026: the two halves of dev and of challenge do its job.

gold.description: The agreed answer. For a training note: the scenario's labels, less the fields the filter blanked. For a test note: the labels on which the scenario (or, for mirror and hiddenV3, the writer) and the blind relabel are equal.

blanked.description: Training notes only. Paths of the fields left without a label, as specs/notes-pipeline.md (section 5) lists them: events/<claim>/<kind>/polarity, events/<claim>/<kind>/date, slots/<id>, requests, values. The claim type is never blanked: a disagreement on it drops the note.

split.description: Only for set clean (700 train, 100 dev, 200 test) and for a slot pack (train or dev).

quote.description: Exact words of the note, copied letter for letter.

occurrence.description: 1-based, when the words occur more than once in the field. Default 1.

start.description: SCRIPT: UTF-16 offset in the field.

normalized.description: yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy-mm or yyyy for a date; digits for an amount, in dinars, with two decimals after a point only for a real fraction. Absent when the guide gives no normalised form. A judge may answer unclear.

roles.description: Event kinds, request kinds or slot ids; empty for none.

polarity.description: unclear is a judge's answer only; it never appears in gold. blanked appears only in the gold of a training note: writer and judge disagreed on this element, so it carries no label (it is not notMentioned) and is listed in blanked.

value.description: yes, no, unknown, a normalised date, digits, a choice id; unclear for a judge; blanked in the gold of a training note when writer and judge disagreed.

claims.description: Claim ids, or the single value outside. A judge may answer unclear.

roles.description: The plaintiff's role, one entry per labelled claim type (SCHEME.md, section 3). Optional: a note labelled before guide version 1.1 has none.

events.description: One entry for EVERY element of every labelled claim type, notMentioned included.

slots.description: One entry for every slot with readFromNote true.

values.description: Every date and amount of the note.

call.description: The id of the writing or judging call: for Codex the event-log file name; for a Claude agent the batch id. Notes of one call never sit on both sides of a split.

judges.description: The blind relabellers of a test note (family, model, date, run). Empty for a training note: no model labels one.

scenario.description: The scenario id of the sampler; absent for hidden v3 (its writers use their own plan).

scenarioFamily.description: Notes of one family never sit on both sides of a split.

polarityFamily.description: For notes written as a group that differs only in polarity: the group id. A group is never split.

trainingAllowed.description: True only when the writer's family is openai, local or code, the filter's family is local or code, and the note is in no test set (notes/TERMS.md). False for every note a Claude model wrote.

composedByCode.description: True for a note assembled by code from short phrases. Such notes are capped at a quarter of any training set and never enter a test set.

samplerCommit.description: The commit of the sampler that drew the scenario; absent for sets that do not use the sampler.

schemeVersion.description: The scheme's version and the commit that froze it, for example 1.0@<commit> (notes/SCHEME.md).

filter.description: Training notes only: what decided keep, blank or drop.

filterWeak.description: True for a note filtered by a model that did not pass the filter trial (HANDBOOK, phase A).

pack.description: For a note of a slot pack: the slot's id (specs/scheme-extension.md).

relation.description: A relation of FactVocabulary.Relations, or unknown.

position.description: A position of FactVocabulary.Positions, or unknown. The pair is one of the claim type's roles in claim-elements.json.

family.description: Never openai, never anthropic: owner, 14 November 2026.

model.description: The Ollama tag and digest of the filter model.

version.description: The sheet's version, for example filter-sheet-1.
